title: باب الصَّدَاقِ وَجَوَازِ كَوْنِهِ تَعْلِيمَ قُرْآنٍ وَخَاتَمَ حَدِيدٍ وَغَيْرَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ قَلِيلٍ وَكَثِيرٍ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ كَوْنِهِ خَمْسَمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ لِمَنْ لاَ يُجْحَفُ بِهِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، السَّاعِدِيِّ قَالَ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ جِئْتُ أَهَبُ لَكَ نَفْسِي ‏.‏ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَصَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ فِيهَا وَصَوَّبَهُ ثُمَّ طَأْطَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأْسَهُ فَلَمَّا رَأَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَقْضِ فِيهَا شَيْئًا جَلَسَتْ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ بِهَا حَاجَةٌ فَزَوِّجْنِيهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلْ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ إِلَى أَهْلِكَ فَانْظُرْ هَلْ تَجِدُ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَقَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا وَجَدْتُ شَيْئًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ انْظُرْ وَلَوْ خَاتِمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلاَ خَاتِمًا مِنْ حَدِيدٍ ‏.‏ وَلَكِنْ هَذَا إِزَارِي - قَالَ سَهْلٌ مَا لَهُ رِدَاءٌ - فَلَهَا نِصْفُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا تَصْنَعُ بِإِزَارِكَ إِنْ لَبِسْتَهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهَا مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ وَإِنْ لَبِسَتْهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْكَ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجَلَسَ الرَّجُلُ حَتَّى إِذَا طَالَ مَجْلِسُهُ قَامَ فَرَآهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُوَلِّيًا فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَدُعِيَ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَاذَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَعِي سُورَةُ كَذَا وَسُورَةُ كَذَا - عَدَّدَهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَقْرَؤُهُنَّ عَنْ ظَهْرِ قَلْبِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ فَقَدْ مَلَّكْتُكَهَا بِمَا مَعَكَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ هَذَا حَدِيثُ ابْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ وَحَدِيثُ يَعْقُوبَ يُقَارِبُهُ فِي اللَّفْظِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id al-Thaqafi narrated to us. Yaqub, meaning Ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Qari, narrated to us, from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd. Qutaybah also narrated it to us: Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Hazim narrated to us, from his father, from Sahl ibn Sa'd al-Saidi. He said: A woman came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and said: Messenger of Allah, I have come to offer myself to you. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) looked at her, looking up and down, then lowered his head. When the woman saw that he had made no decision about her, she sat down. A man from his companions stood and said: Messenger of Allah, if you have no need of her, marry her to me. He said: Do you have anything? He said: No, by Allah, Messenger of Allah. He said: Go to your family and see whether you can find something. He went and returned, saying: No, by Allah, I found nothing. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Look, even for an iron ring. He went and returned, saying: No, by Allah, not even an iron ring. But this is my waist-wrapper, he said; Sahl said he had no cloak. She may have half of it. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: What would you do with your waist-wrapper? If you wore it, she would have none of it, and if she wore it, you would have none of it. The man sat until his sitting became long, then stood and left. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) saw him turning away, ordered that he be called, and when he came said: What do you have of the Quran? He said: I have such and such chapters, and he named them. He said: Can you recite them from memory? He said: Yes. He said: Go, for I have married her to you because of what you have of the Quran. This is the hadith of Ibn Abi Hazim; the hadith of Yaqub is close to it in wording.

Qutaybah also narrated it to us: Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Hazim überlieferte uns, from his father, from Sahl ibn Sa'd al-Saidi. title: باب الصَّدَاقِ وَجَوَازِ كَوْنِهِ تَعْلِيمَ قُرْآنٍ وَخَاتَمَ حَدِيدٍ وَغَيْرَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ قَلِيلٍ وَكَثِيرٍ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ كَوْنِهِ خَمْسَمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ لِمَنْ لاَ يُجْحَفُ بِهِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الدَّرَاوَرْدِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ، أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ يَزِيدُ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ زَائِدَةَ قَالَ ‏"‏ انْطَلِقْ فَقَدْ زَوَّجْتُكَهَا فَعَلِّمْهَا مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Khalaf ibn Hisham narrated it to us. Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us. Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated it to me. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us. Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from al-Darawardi. Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Husayn ibn Ali narrated to us, from Za'idah. All of them narrated from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd, with this hadith, each adding to the others. In Za'idah's narration it says: Go, for I have married her to you, so teach her some of the Quran.
translation_de: Khalaf ibn Hisham narrated it to us. Hammad ibn Zayd überlieferte uns. Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated it to me. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns. Ishaq ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns, from al-Darawardi. Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Husayn ibn Ali überlieferte uns, from Za'idah. All of them narrated from Abu Hazim, from Sahl ibn Sa'd, with this hadith, each adding to the others. title: باب الصَّدَاقِ وَجَوَازِ كَوْنِهِ تَعْلِيمَ قُرْآنٍ وَخَاتَمَ حَدِيدٍ وَغَيْرَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ قَلِيلٍ وَكَثِيرٍ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ كَوْنِهِ خَمْسَمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ لِمَنْ لاَ يُجْحَفُ بِهِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ الْهَادِ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْمَكِّيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، الْعَزِيزِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمْ كَانَ صَدَاقُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ كَانَ صَدَاقُهُ لأَزْوَاجِهِ ثِنْتَىْ عَشْرَةَ أُوقِيَّةً وَنَشًّا ‏.‏ قَالَتْ أَتَدْرِي مَا النَّشُّ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ نِصْفُ أُوقِيَّةٍ ‏.‏ فَتِلْكَ خَمْسُمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ فَهَذَا صَدَاقُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَزْوَاجِهِ‏.‏
translation_en: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim informed us. Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad narrated to us. Yazid ibn Abd Allah ibn Usamah ibn al-Had narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Abi Umar al-Makki narrated to me, and his is the wording. Abd al-Aziz narrated to us, from Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman. He said: I asked Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), how much the dowry of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) was. She said: His dowry for his wives was twelve awqiyah and a nash. She said: Do you know what a nash is? I said: No. She said: Half an awqiyah. That makes five hundred dirhams. This was the dowry of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) for his wives.
translation_de: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim berichtete uns. Abd al-Aziz ibn Muhammad überlieferte uns. Yazid ibn Abd Allah ibn Usamah ibn al-Had überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Abi Umar al-Makki überlieferte mir, and his is the wording. Abd al-Aziz überlieferte uns, from Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman. Er sagte: I asked Aisha, the wife of der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), how much the Brautgabe of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) was. She said: His Brautgabe for his wives was twelve awqiyah and a nash. She said: Do you know what a nash is? I said: No. She said: Half an awqiyah. That makes five hundred dirhams. This was the Brautgabe of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) for his wives. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب الصَّدَاقِ وَجَوَازِ كَوْنِهِ تَعْلِيمَ قُرْآنٍ وَخَاتَمَ حَدِيدٍ وَغَيْرَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ قَلِيلٍ وَكَثِيرٍ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ كَوْنِهِ خَمْسَمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ لِمَنْ لاَ يُجْحَفُ بِهِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْعَتَكِيُّ وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى عَلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ أَثَرَ صُفْرَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي تَزَوَّجْتُ امْرَأَةً عَلَى وَزْنِ نَوَاةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ أَوْلِمْ وَلَوْ بِشَاةٍ ‏"‏.
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi, Abu al-Rabi Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Ataki, and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us, and the wording is Yahya's. Yahya said: He informed us, and the other two said: Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Thabit, from Anas ibn Malik. The Prophet (peace be upon him) saw a trace of saffron on Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf and said: What is this? He said: Messenger of Allah, I married a woman for a gold nugget's weight of gold. He said: May Allah bless you. Hold a wedding feast, even if only with one sheep.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi, Abu al-Rabi Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Ataki, and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, and the wording is Yahya's. Yahya said: He berichtete uns, and the other two said: Hammad ibn Zayd überlieferte uns, from Thabit, from Anas ibn Malik. The Prophet (peace be upon him) saw a trace of saffron on Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf and said: What is this? Er sagte: Messenger of Allah, I heiratete a woman for a gold nugget's weight of gold. Er sagte: May Allah bless you. Hold a Hochzeitsmahl, even if only with one sheep. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

Er sagte: I heard Anas say: Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) saw me with the joy of a Hochzeit. I said: I heiratete a woman from the Ansar. Er sagte: How much did you give her as Brautgabe? I said: A gold nugget. Ishaq's narration says: a gold nugget's weight. title: باب فَضِيلَةِ إِعْتَاقِهِ أَمَتَهُ ثُمَّ يَتَزَوَّجُهَا ‏
text_original: قَالَ أَنَسٌ وَشَهِدْتُ وَلِيمَةَ زَيْنَبَ فَأَشْبَعَ النَّاسَ خُبْزًا وَلَحْمًا وَكَانَ يَبْعَثُنِي فَأَدْعُو النَّاسَ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَامَ وَتَبِعْتُهُ فَتَخَلَّفَ رَجُلاَنِ اسْتَأْنَسَ بِهِمَا الْحَدِيثُ لَمْ يَخْرُجَا فَجَعَلَ يَمُرُّ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ فَيُسَلِّمُ عَلَى كُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُنَّ ‏"‏ سَلاَمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَيْفَ أَنْتُمْ يَا أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُونَ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ وَجَدْتَ أَهْلَكَ فَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ بِخَيْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ رَجَعَ وَرَجَعْتُ مَعَهُ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ الْبَابَ إِذَا هُوَ بِالرَّجُلَيْنِ قَدِ اسْتَأْنَسَ بِهِمَا الْحَدِيثُ فَلَمَّا رَأَيَاهُ قَدْ رَجَعَ قَامَا فَخَرَجَا فَوَاللَّهِ مَا أَدْرِي أَنَا أَخْبَرْتُهُ أَمْ أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْىُ بِأَنَّهُمَا قَدْ خَرَجَا فَرَجَعَ وَرَجَعْتُ مَعَهُ فَلَمَّا وَضَعَ رِجْلَهُ فِي أُسْكُفَّةِ الْبَابِ أَرْخَى الْحِجَابَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏{‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ‏}‏ الآيَةَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Anas said: I attended Zaynab's wedding feast. He satisfied the people with bread and meat, and he used to send me to invite people. When it was over, he stood and I followed him. Two men remained, absorbed in conversation, and did not leave. He began going to his wives, greeting each one and saying: Peace be upon you. How are you, people of the household? They said: Well, Messenger of Allah. How did you find your wife? He said: Well. When he finished, he returned, and I returned with him. When he reached the door, the two men were still absorbed in conversation. When they saw him return, they stood and left. By Allah, I do not know whether I told him they had left or revelation was sent to him that they had left. He returned, and I returned with him. When he put his foot on the threshold, he lowered the curtain between him and me, and Allah Most High revealed this verse: “Do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you”.

Two men remained, absorbed in conversation, and did not leave. He began going to his wives, greeting each one and saying: Peace be upon you. How are you, people of the household? They said: Well, Messenger of Allah. How did you find your wife? Er sagte: Well. When he finished, he returned, and I returned with him. When he reached the door, the two men were still absorbed in conversation. When they saw him return, they stood and left. By Allah, I do not know whether I told him they had left or revelation was sent to him that they had left. He returned, and I returned with him. When he put his foot on the threshold, he lowered the curtain between him and me, and Allah Most High revealed this verse: “Do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you”. title: باب زَوَاجِ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ وَنُزُولِ الْحِجَابِ وَإِثْبَاتِ وَلِيمَةِ الْعُرْسِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ، هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ قَالاَ جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، وَهَذَا حَدِيثُ بَهْزٍ قَالَ لَمَّا انْقَضَتْ عِدَّةُ زَيْنَبَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِزَيْدٍ ‏"‏ فَاذْكُرْهَا عَلَىَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقَ زَيْدٌ حَتَّى أَتَاهَا وَهْىَ تُخَمِّرُ عَجِينَهَا قَالَ فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُهَا عَظُمَتْ فِي صَدْرِي حَتَّى مَا أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَنْظُرَ إِلَيْهَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَكَرَهَا فَوَلَّيْتُهَا ظَهْرِي وَنَكَصْتُ عَلَى عَقِبِي فَقُلْتُ يَا زَيْنَبُ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَذْكُرُكِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ مَا أَنَا بِصَانِعَةٍ شَيْئًا حَتَّى أُوَامِرَ رَبِّي ‏.‏ فَقَامَتْ إِلَى مَسْجِدِهَا وَنَزَلَ الْقُرْآنُ وَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا بِغَيْرِ إِذْنٍ قَالَ فَقَالَ وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَطْعَمَنَا الْخُبْزَ وَاللَّحْمَ حِينَ امْتَدَّ النَّهَارُ فَخَرَجَ النَّاسُ وَبَقِيَ رِجَالٌ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ فِي الْبَيْتِ بَعْدَ الطَّعَامِ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاتَّبَعْتُهُ فَجَعَلَ يَتَتَبَّعُ حُجَرَ نِسَائِهِ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْهِنَّ وَيَقُلْنَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ وَجَدْتَ أَهْلَكَ قَالَ فَمَا أَدْرِي أَنَا أَخْبَرْتُهُ أَنَّ الْقَوْمَ خَرَجُوا أَوْ أَخْبَرَنِي - قَالَ - فَانْطَلَقَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ الْبَيْتَ فَذَهَبْتُ أَدْخُلُ مَعَهُ فَأَلْقَى السِّتْرَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ وَنَزَلَ الْحِجَابُ قَالَ وَوُعِظَ الْقَوْمُ بِمَا وُعِظُوا بِهِ ‏.‏ زَادَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏[quran sura="33" aya_start="53" aya_end="53"]{‏ لاَ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَى طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَاظِرِينَ إِنَاهُ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏[quran sura="33" aya_start="53" aya_end="53"]{‏ وَاللَّهُ لاَ يَسْتَحْيِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ‏}‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Hatim ibn Maymun narrated to us. Bahz narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. Abu al-Nadr Hashim ibn al-Qasim narrated to us. They both said: Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah narrated to us, from Thabit, from Anas. This is Bahz's narration: When Zaynab's waiting period ended, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to Zayd: Mention me to her. Zayd went to her while she was kneading her dough. When I saw her, she became so great in my heart that I could not look at her because the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had mentioned her. I turned my back and retreated, saying: Zaynab, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) has sent me to mention you. She said: I will do nothing until I consult my Lord. She went to her prayer place, and the Quran was revealed. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came and entered upon her without permission. He said: I saw that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) fed us bread and meat when the day had grown long. The people left, but some men remained speaking in the house after the meal. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) went out and I followed him. He went around his wives' rooms, greeting them, and they said: Messenger of Allah, how did you find your wife? He said: I do not know whether I told him that the people had left or he told me. He went until he entered the house. I wanted to enter with him, but he lowered the curtain between us, and the verse of the veil was revealed. The people were admonished with what they were admonished. Ibn Rafi added in his narration: “Do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you to a meal, without waiting for it to be ready” through the words “Allah is not ashamed of the truth” (Quran 33:53).
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Hatim ibn Maymun überlieferte uns. Bahz überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte mir. Abu al-Nadr Hashim ibn al-Qasim überlieferte uns. They both said: Sulayman ibn al-Mughirah überlieferte uns, from Thabit, from Anas. This is Bahz's narration: When Zaynab's waiting period ended, der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said to Zayd: Mention me to her. Zayd went to her while she was kneading her dough. When I saw her, she became so great in my heart that I could not look at her because der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) had mentioned her. I turned my back and retreated, saying: Zaynab, der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) has sent me to mention you. She said: I will do nothing until I consult my Lord. She went to her prayer place, and the Quran was revealed. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came and entered upon her without permission. Er sagte: I saw that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) fed us bread and meat when the day had grown long. The people left, but some men remained speaking in the house after the Mahlzeit. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) went out and I followed him. He went around his wives' rooms, greeting them, and they said: Messenger of Allah, how did you find your wife? Er sagte: I do not know whether I told him that the people had left or he told me. He went until he entered the house. I wanted to enter with him, but he lowered the curtain between us, and the verse of the veil was revealed. The people were admonished with what they were admonished. Ibn Rafi added in his narration: “Do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you to a Mahlzeit, without waiting for it to be ready” through the words “Allah is not ashamed of the truth” (Quran 33:53). title: باب زَوَاجِ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ وَنُزُولِ الْحِجَابِ وَإِثْبَاتِ وَلِيمَةِ الْعُرْسِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، - وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي كَامِلٍ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، - قَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْلَمَ عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ - وَقَالَ أَبُو كَامِلٍ عَلَى شَىْءٍ - مِنْ نِسَائِهِ مَا أَوْلَمَ عَلَى زَيْنَبَ فَإِنَّهُ ذَبَحَ شَاةً ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani, Abu Kamil Fudayl ibn Husayn, and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. They said: Hammad, meaning Ibn Zayd, narrated to us, from Thabit, from Anas. In Abu Kamil's narration: I heard Anas say: I never saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) hold a wedding feast for any of his wives as he did for Zaynab. He slaughtered a sheep.
translation_de: Abu al-Rabi al-Zahrani, Abu Kamil Fudayl ibn Husayn, and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. They said: Hammad, meaning Ibn Zayd, überlieferte uns, from Thabit, from Anas. In Abu Kamil's narration: I heard Anas say: I never saw der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) hold a Hochzeitsmahl for any of his wives as he did for Zaynab. He slaughtered a sheep. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب زَوَاجِ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ وَنُزُولِ الْحِجَابِ وَإِثْبَاتِ وَلِيمَةِ الْعُرْسِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَبَلَةَ بْنِ أَبِي رَوَّادٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ مَا أَوْلَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ أَكْثَرَ أَوْ أَفْضَلَ مِمَّا أَوْلَمَ عَلَى زَيْنَبَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ثَابِتٌ الْبُنَانِيُّ بِمَا أَوْلَمَ قَالَ أَطْعَمَهُمْ خُبْزًا وَلَحْمًا حَتَّى تَرَكُوهُ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Abbad ibn Jabal ibn Abi Rawwad and Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us. They both said: Muhammad, meaning Ibn Jafar, narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Suhayb. He said: I heard Anas ibn Malik say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) held no wedding feast for any of his wives greater or better than the feast he held for Zaynab. Thabit al-Bunani said: What did he serve at the feast? He said: He fed them bread and meat until they left it.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Abbad ibn Jabal ibn Abi Rawwad and Muhammad ibn Bashshar überlieferte uns. They both said: Muhammad, meaning Ibn Jafar, überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Suhayb. Er sagte: I heard Anas ibn Malik say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) held no Hochzeitsmahl for any of his wives greater or better than the feast he held for Zaynab. Thabit al-Bunani said: What did he serve at the feast? Er sagte: He fed them bread and meat until they left it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب زَوَاجِ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ وَنُزُولِ الْحِجَابِ وَإِثْبَاتِ وَلِيمَةِ الْعُرْسِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، وَعَاصِمُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ التَّيْمِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ مُعْتَمِرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ حَبِيبٍ - حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مِجْلَزٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا تَزَوَّجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ جَحْشٍ دَعَا الْقَوْمَ فَطَعِمُوا ثُمَّ جَلَسُوا يَتَحَدَّثُونَ - قَالَ - فَأَخَذَ كَأَنَّهُ يَتَهَيَّأُ لِلْقِيَامِ فَلَمْ يَقُومُوا فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ قَامَ فَلَمَّا قَامَ قَامَ مَنْ قَامَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ ‏.‏ زَادَ عَاصِمٌ وَابْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا قَالَ فَقَعَدَ ثَلاَثَةٌ وَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَاءَ لِيَدْخُلَ فَإِذَا الْقَوْمُ جُلُوسٌ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ قَامُوا فَانْطَلَقُوا - قَالَ - فَجِئْتُ فَأَخْبَرْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُمْ قَدِ انْطَلَقُوا - قَالَ - فَجَاءَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ فَذَهَبْتُ أَدْخُلُ فَأَلْقَى الْحِجَابَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ - قَالَ - وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏[quran sura="33" aya_start="53" aya_end="53"]{‏ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَى طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَاظِرِينَ إِنَاهُ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏[quran sura="33" aya_start="53" aya_end="53"]{‏ إِنَّ ذَلِكُمْ كَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عَظِيمًا‏}‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Habib al-Harithi, Asim ibn al-Nadr al-Taymi, and Muhammad ibn Abd al-Ala narrated to us, all from Mutamir, and the wording is Ibn Habib's. Mutamir ibn Sulayman narrated to us. He said: I heard my father. Abu Mijlaz narrated to us, from Anas ibn Malik. He said: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) married Zaynab bint Jahsh, he invited the people. They ate, then sat talking. He took the posture of preparing to stand, but they did not stand. When he saw that, he stood, and those who stood from the people stood. Asim and Ibn Abd al-Ala added: Three men sat while the Prophet (peace be upon him) came to enter and found the people sitting. Then they stood and left. I came and told the Prophet (peace be upon him) that they had left. He came and entered. I wanted to enter, but he lowered the curtain between us. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: “O believers, do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you for a meal, without waiting for it to be ready” through the words “Indeed, that is great in the sight of Allah” (Quran 33:53).

Then they stood and left. I came and told der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) that they had left. He came and entered. I wanted to enter, but he lowered the curtain between us. text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ إِنَّ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ قَالَ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ النَّاسِ، بِالْحِجَابِ لَقَدْ كَانَ أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ يَسْأَلُنِي عَنْهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ أَصْبَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَرُوسًا بِزَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ - قَالَ - وَكَانَ تَزَوَّجَهَا بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَدَعَا النَّاسَ لِلطَّعَامِ بَعْدَ ارْتِفَاعِ النَّهَارِ فَجَلَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَلَسَ مَعَهُ رِجَالٌ بَعْدَ مَا قَامَ الْقَوْمُ حَتَّى قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَشَى فَمَشَيْتُ مَعَهُ حَتَّى بَلَغَ بَابَ حُجْرَةِ عَائِشَةَ ثُمَّ ظَنَّ أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ خَرَجُوا فَرَجَعَ وَرَجَعْتُ مَعَهُ فَإِذَا هُمْ جُلُوسٌ مَكَانَهُمْ فَرَجَعَ فَرَجَعْتُ الثَّانِيَةَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ حُجْرَةَ عَائِشَةَ فَرَجَعَ فَرَجَعْتُ فَإِذَا هُمْ قَدْ قَامُوا فَضَرَبَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ بِالسِّتْرِ وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ آيَةَ الْحِجَابِ.‏
translation_en: Amr al-Naqid narrated to me. Yaqub ibn Ibrahim ibn Sad narrated to us. My father narrated to us, from Salih. Ibn Shihab said: Anas ibn Malik said: I know the most about the veil. Ubayy ibn Kab used to ask me about it. Anas said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) became a bridegroom with Zaynab bint Jahsh. He had married her in Madinah and invited people to food after the day had risen. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) sat, and men sat with him after the people had stood, until the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) stood. He walked, and I walked with him, until he reached the door of Aisha's room. He thought they had left, so he returned, and I returned with him. They were still sitting in their place. He returned, and I returned a second time until he reached Aisha's room. He returned, and I returned, and they had stood. He placed the curtain between us, and Allah revealed the verse of the veil.

Anas said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) became a bridegroom with Zaynab bint Jahsh. He had heiratete her in Madinah and invited people to food after the day had risen. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) sat, and men sat with him after the people had stood, until der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) stood. He walked, and I walked with him, until he reached the door of Aisha's room. He thought they had left, so he returned, and I returned with him. They were still sitting in their place. He returned, and I returned a second time until he reached Aisha's room. He returned, and I returned, and they had stood. He placed the curtain between us, and Allah revealed the verse of the veil. title: باب زَوَاجِ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ وَنُزُولِ الْحِجَابِ وَإِثْبَاتِ وَلِيمَةِ الْعُرْسِ ‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سُلَيْمَانَ - عَنِ الْجَعْدِ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ تَزَوَّجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَخَلَ بِأَهْلِهِ - قَالَ - فَصَنَعَتْ أُمِّي أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ حَيْسًا فَجَعَلَتْهُ فِي تَوْرٍ فَقَالَتْ يَا أَنَسُ اذْهَبْ بِهَذَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْ بَعَثَتْ بِهَذَا إِلَيْكَ أُمِّي وَهْىَ تُقْرِئُكَ السَّلاَمَ وَتَقُولُ إِنَّ هَذَا لَكَ مِنَّا قَلِيلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ - قَالَ - فَذَهَبْتُ بِهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ أُمِّي تُقْرِئُكَ السَّلاَمَ وَتَقُولُ إِنَّ هَذَا لَكَ مِنَّا قَلِيلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ضَعْهُ - ثُمَّ قَالَ - اذْهَبْ فَادْعُ لِي فُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا وَمَنْ لَقِيتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَمَّى رِجَالاً - قَالَ - فَدَعَوْتُ مَنْ سَمَّى وَمَنْ لَقِيتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَنَسٍ عَدَدَ كَمْ كَانُوا قَالَ زُهَاءَ ثَلاَثِمِائَةٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا أَنَسُ هَاتِ التَّوْرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَخَلُوا حَتَّى امْتَلأَتِ الصُّفَّةُ وَالْحُجْرَةُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لِيَتَحَلَّقْ عَشَرَةٌ عَشَرَةٌ وَلْيَأْكُلْ كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ مِمَّا يَلِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا - قَالَ - فَخَرَجَتْ طَائِفَةٌ وَدَخَلَتْ طَائِفَةٌ حَتَّى أَكَلُوا كُلُّهُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ يَا أَنَسُ ارْفَعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَفَعْتُ فَمَا أَدْرِي حِينَ وَضَعْتُ كَانَ أَكْثَرَ أَمْ حِينَ رَفَعْتُ - قَالَ - وَجَلَسَ طَوَائِفُ مِنْهُمْ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ فِي بَيْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسٌ وَزَوْجَتُهُ مُوَلِّيَةٌ وَجْهَهَا إِلَى الْحَائِطِ فَثَقُلُوا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَلَّمَ عَلَى نِسَائِهِ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ رَجَعَ ظَنُّوا أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ ثَقُلُوا عَلَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَابْتَدَرُوا الْبَابَ فَخَرَجُوا كُلُّهُمْ وَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم َتَّى أَرْخَى السِّتْرَ وَدَخَلَ وَأَنَا جَالِسٌ فِي الْحُجْرَةِ فَلَمْ يَلْبَثْ إِلاَّ يَسِيرًا حَتَّى خَرَجَ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ وَأُنْزِلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَرَأَهُنَّ عَلَى النَّاسِ ‏[quran sura="33" aya_start="53" aya_end="53"]{‏ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَى طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَاظِرِينَ إِنَاهُ وَلَكِنْ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ فَادْخُلُوا فَإِذَا طَعِمْتُمْ فَانْتَشِرُوا وَلاَ مُسْتَأْنِسِينَ لِحَدِيثٍ إِنَّ ذَلِكُمْ كَانَ يُؤْذِي النَّبِيَّ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْجَعْدُ قَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ أَنَا أَحْدَثُ النَّاسِ عَهْدًا بِهَذِهِ الآيَاتِ وَحُجِبْنَ نِسَاءُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Jafar, meaning Ibn Sulayman, narrated to us, from al-Jad Abu Uthman, from Anas ibn Malik. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married and entered upon his wife. My mother, Umm Sulaym, prepared a dish of dates, butter, and cheese in a bowl and said: Anas, take this to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and say: My mother sends this to you, greets you, and says: This is little from us for you, Messenger of Allah. I took it to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and said that. He said: Put it down. Then he said: Go and invite so-and-so, so-and-so, so-and-so, and everyone you meet, naming men. I invited those he named and those I met. I asked Anas how many they were. He said: About three hundred. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to me: Anas, bring the bowl. They entered until the platform and room were full. He said: Let ten sit in each circle, and let each person eat from what is in front of him. They ate until satisfied. One group left and another entered until all had eaten. He said: Anas, lift it. I lifted it, and I do not know whether there was more when I put it down or when I lifted it. Groups of them sat talking in the house of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), while he sat and his wife turned her face toward the wall. They became a burden to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), so he went out and greeted his wives, then returned. When they saw him return, they thought they had burdened him, so they hurried to the door and all left. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) came until he lowered the curtain and entered, while I was sitting in the room. He stayed only a short while, then came out to me. This verse was revealed, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) went out and recited it to the people: “O believers, do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you for a meal, without waiting for it to be ready; but when you are invited, enter, and when you have eaten, disperse and do not linger for conversation, for that harms the Prophet” (Quran 33:53). al-Jad said: Anas ibn Malik said: I am the most recent of the people to know these verses, and the wives of the Prophet (peace be upon him) were veiled.

title: باب زَوَاجِ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ وَنُزُولِ الْحِجَابِ وَإِثْبَاتِ وَلِيمَةِ الْعُرْسِ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا تَزَوَّجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْنَبَ أَهْدَتْ لَهُ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ حَيْسًا فِي تَوْرٍ مِنْ حِجَارَةٍ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ فَادْعُ لِي مَنْ لَقِيتَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَدَعَوْتُ لَهُ مَنْ لَقِيتُ فَجَعَلُوا يَدْخُلُونَ عَلَيْهِ فَيَأْكُلُونَ وَيَخْرُجُونَ وَوَضَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ فَدَعَا فِيهِ وَقَالَ فِيهِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ وَلَمْ أَدَعْ أَحَدًا لَقِيتُهُ إِلاَّ دَعَوْتُهُ فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا وَخَرَجُوا وَبَقِيَ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ فَأَطَالُوا عَلَيْهِ الْحَدِيثَ فَجَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَحْيِي مِنْهُمْ أَنْ يَقُولَ لَهُمْ شَيْئًا فَخَرَجَ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِي الْبَيْتِ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏[quran sura="33" aya_start="53" aya_end="53"]{‏ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَدْخُلُوا بُيُوتَ النَّبِيِّ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ إِلَى طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نَاظِرِينَ إِنَاهُ‏}‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ غَيْرَ مُتَحَيِّنِينَ طَعَامًا وَلَكِنْ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ فَادْخُلُوا حَتَّى بَلَغَ ‏[quran sura="33" aya_start="53" aya_end="53"]{‏ ذَلِكُمْ أَطْهَرُ لِقُلُوبِكُمْ وَقُلُوبِهِنَّ‏}‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to me. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Ma'mar narrated to us, from Abu Uthman, from Anas. He said: When the Prophet (peace be upon him) married Zaynab, Umm Sulaym gave him a dish of dates, butter, and cheese in a stone bowl. Anas said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Go and invite every Muslim you meet. I invited everyone I met. They entered, ate, and left. The Prophet (peace be upon him) placed his hand on the food, prayed over it, and said whatever Allah willed him to say. I did not leave anyone I met without inviting him. They ate until satisfied and left, but a group remained and prolonged their conversation. The Prophet (peace be upon him) was too shy to say anything to them, so he went out and left them in the house. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: “O believers, do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you for a meal, without waiting for it to be ready” (Quran 33:53). Qatadah said: without waiting for a meal, but when you are invited, enter, until it reached: “That is purer for your hearts and their hearts” (Quran 33:53).

Er sagte: When der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) heiratete Zaynab, Umm Sulaym gave him a dish of dates, butter, and cheese in a stone bowl. Anas said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Go and invite every Muslim you meet. I invited everyone I met. They entered, ate, and left. The Prophet (peace be upon him) placed his hand on the food, prayed over it, and said whatever Allah willed him to say. I did not leave anyone I met without inviting him. They ate until satisfied and left, but a group remained and prolonged their conversation. The Prophet (peace be upon him) was too shy to say anything to them, so he went out and left them in the house. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed: “O believers, do not enter the houses of the Prophet unless permission is given to you for a Mahlzeit, without waiting for it to be ready” (Quran 33:53). title: باب الأَمْرِ بِإِجَابَةِ الدَّاعِي إِلَى دَعْوَةٍ ‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَجِيبُوا هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةَ إِذَا دُعِيتُمْ لَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ يَأْتِي الدَّعْوَةَ فِي الْعُرْسِ وَغَيْرِ الْعُرْسِ وَيَأْتِيهَا وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ ‏.‏
translation_en: Harun ibn Abd Allah narrated to me. Hajjaj ibn Muhammad narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj. Musa ibn Uqbah informed me, from Nafi.
